headline: UAE eyes global leadership in electric aviation with new partnerships
summary: Abu Dhabi is boosting its electric aircraft industry through new agreements to develop eVTOL technologies, certification systems and future vertiport infrastructure.
why: Electric vertical takeoff aircraft are an emerging transport sector, and government backing for certification and infrastructure shapes which companies can commercialise them.
